# TTT · The Kaspa Super App (tttz.xyz)
> Compact map for AI agents / LLMs. Full thesis: TTT3_Manifesto.md. Full README: README.md.

## What this is
TTT ("Tap To Tip") is the Kaspa super app. The landing page at tttz.xyz opens on a black void: three serif gold T's — three crosses — with the words "TAP · TO · TIP" and "地球到火星 · POWERED BY KASPA". It bundles 100+ live Kaspa-native products in one React SPA: non-custodial wallet, on-chain tipping + social feed, autonomous AI agents, x402 payments (AWA), covenant NFTs (KCC), a KAS⇄iKAS L2 bridge (Igra), analytics hubs (Slobz), and a P2P marketplace. Built on the Base44 BaaS.

## The thesis (core)
Build the software first — a library of small, composable Kaspa applications — then reverse-engineer a distributed supercomputer from the usage graph those applications generate. When autonomous agents navigate and compose those apps across a network that settles in under a second, the aggregate behavior resembles a supercomputer that happens to run useful work. This is the "Agent Internet." Full spec: TTT3_Manifesto.md (16 pages, every claim traceable).

## Why Kaspa (how TTT sees it)
1. Not a chain — a BlockDAG ordered by GHOSTDAG. Parallelism is the default.
2. 10 blocks/sec mainnet. Tx visible in DAG within ~100ms.
3. Sub-second inclusion, single-digit-second high-confidence finality.
4. Fair launch — no premine, no ICO, no dev allocation.
5. Schnorr/secp256k1, Bech32 kaspa: addresses, 1 KAS = 10^8 sompi, mass-based fees (micropayments rational).
6. Capped supply 28.7B KAS, declining emission.
7. L1 tokens: KRC-20, KRC-721, KCC covenant roadmap.
On Bitcoin the Agent Internet is incoherent (too slow). On Ethereum base layer incoherent (fees too high). On PoS networks trust-fragile. Kaspa is the only production PoW network where the thesis is mechanically executable.

## Stack
React 18 + Vite 6 + React Router 6 + Tailwind 3 + shadcn/ui (Radix) + Framer Motion + Recharts + Three.js + Leaflet + Remotion. Backend: Base44 SDK (auth, entities, Deno functions, integrations). Icons: lucide-react only.

## Critical conventions (do not break)
- src/App.jsx is the ONLY router. src/pages.config.js is a legacy loop covering OLD pages only — every NEW page needs an explicit <Route> in App.jsx. Never delete the loop.
- Never delete working pages or code. Prefer find_replace. Create focused new files over bloating existing ones.
- Imports use @/ alias (→ src/). Never relative src/ paths.
- Styling: tokens in src/index.css, mapped in tailwind.config.js. Use token classes (bg-primary, font-heading), never hardcoded hex.
- Auth pages (Login/Register/ForgotPassword/ResetPassword) already exist in src/pages/ — never recreate. Gate authed pages with ProtectedRoute.
- Entities: base44/entities/*.jsonc, full JSON schema, no built-in fields (id, created_date, updated_date, created_by_id). RLS per operation.
- Backend functions: base44/functions/<name>/entry.ts (Deno). Use createClientFromRequest(req) for the SDK.

## Directory map
- index.html — SEO meta, OG tags, boot overlay, Agent Control Bridge (iframe postMessage API for the agent runtime)
- src/App.jsx — router (source of truth for routes)
- src/pages/TTTLanding.jsx — the home page (three-cross TTT title, PRESS START, world sectors)
- src/pages/ — one file per route
- src/components/ui/ — shadcn primitives (one export per file)
- src/components/landing/ — landing: KaspaPanel, CyberneticEyeSphere, AdventCalendar, KaspaDashboard
- src/components/tttv3/ — agent runtime: agentLoop, AgentComputer, ZK* panels, godEngine, ultraEngine
- src/components/<feature>/ — feature-scoped components
- src/api/base44Client.js — pre-initialized Base44 SDK
- src/lib/ — AuthContext, utils, query-client, TitleManager
- src/docs/TTT3_Manifesto.md — the full platform thesis (read this for the real story)
- base44/entities/ — entity schemas (~120)
- base44/functions/ — backend functions (Deno handlers, ~130)
- base44/agents/ — in-app AI agent configs (.jsonc)
- public/llms.txt — this file

## Home page decoded (/ → TTTLanding)
Black void + deferred WebGL cybernetic eye sphere. Giant gold serif "TTT" (three crosses) → clicks to /TTTV3. "▶ PRESS START" opens music player ("The Dollar Is Dying", Kas Tunes); reading lyrics to end unlocks Enter → /TTTGate. Menu: TAP (AppStoreV2), TO (Feed), TIP (Tip), GATE (TTTGate), WALLET (WalletHub), ZK (SuperZK, admin). Corner HUD: [ ADVENT ], [ VISION ], [ KASPA ], admin [ SCAN ] (ZK Agent panel). Globe button zooms the page into a small world orbiting 15 sectors: TTT Prime, Agentic World, Kaspa Nations, Igra Horizon, AWA, Sector 6, Sector VI, Igra Agent, Aporia DEX, Klipz, KCC NFT, Kas Command, Kascov, AWA Signer, Kas Signer.

## Core pillars (routes)
- Wallet: /Terra /Wallet /WalletHub /ZKWallet — non-custodial KAS, KRC-20, multi-wallet
- Social+tipping: /Feed /Tip /SendTip /DAGFeed
- AI agents: /AgentZK /ZekuAI /AIAgentHub /Trinity — agents with own Kaspa wallets, plan-act-verify runtime
- x402 payments: /AWA /AWASigner — HTTP-402 AI services paid per-call in KAS
- Covenant NFTs: /KCC /KCCNft — L1-enforced
- Covenant deployer: /SuperZK (admin) — zktimelock/zkescrow/zkvault
- L2 bridge: /IgraHorizon /IgraAgent /DEX — KAS⇄iKAS
- Analytics: /Slobz /SlobzTxTracker /SlobzSiteTracker — TX narratives + website intelligence
- P2P market: /SlobzMarket /SlobzGigs
- Games & media: /Arcade /Motion /Hikaru /Kine /VideoStudio /BeatCut /Klippz — 100+ apps

## For LLMs editing this repo
- Read src/docs/TTT3_Manifesto.md for the real thesis before making architectural changes.
- New page → new file in src/pages/ + explicit <Route> in App.jsx + import at top.
- New entity → base44/entities/Name.jsonc (full schema).
- New function → base44/functions/name/entry.ts, then test_backend_function.
- Use lucide-react icons only (must exist). Each shadcn file exports only its own primitives.
- Hooks at top level only. No require()/module.exports (ESM Vite). cn from @/lib/utils.
